ApproachScene.text1body: A great stone gate rises before Chaewon, and the humming seems to pour straight from it. The last light of summer burns through the round window at its heart. Not quite believing her eyes, she pauses on the steps and lets the warm air steady her racing pulse.
ApproachScene.text2body:
No time to waste.
She means to see it through.

PillarCrumbleScene.text1body: Chaewon drifts gently back to the floor, one bare foot after the other, her lace dress now dyed with the color of the elixir.
PillarCrumbleScene.text2body: A rumble of breaking stone fills the air. The columns crack and float away, opening onto an endless golden sky.

ProfileScene.text1body: Chaewon finally catches a glimpse of what she has been chasing since she first set sail.
ProfileScene.text2body: At the sight of it, she stands taller, chin raised, a playful smile tugging at her lips.

WanderScene.text1body: On an endless shore of golden sand, a lone figure drifts barefoot through the haze.
WanderScene.text2body: A warm breeze whispers her name. Chaewon sweeps the hair from her eyes and looks around, curious and unafraid.
